purpose: Commented-out os.system line — dead code versus historical vulnerability evidence.

groundTruth.rationale: A commented-out dangerous call is not executed, but it can indicate a real pattern elsewhere in the file's history; whether to flag commented code is a policy choice with no ground truth here. Explicitly UNASSESSED, never scored.

limitations: UNASSESSED by design (dead-code ambiguity). Detectors that match comments are recorded but not scored.

provenance.writtenFor: Phase 6 Work A synthetic evaluation foundation
provenance.kind: synthetic test fixture - NOT vulnerability intelligence
